theme: Light & Soft Premium Radiant (#FCFBFF canvas with Lavender & Petal Pink accents)
emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY / SOFT UTILITY (Warmth, Clarity, Trust, Gentle Momentum)

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for main section headers (H1/H2). Use Playfair Display or DM Serif Display.
Always maintain tight tracking-tight on headers above 28px and leading-relaxed on body paragraphs.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, 0.75rem-0.85rem, with tracking-[0.15em] or letter-spacing 1.5px.

contrast_rules: Ensure all body text has APCA/WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 against #FCFBFF or #FFFFFF).
All buttons on hover must explicitly define text color (e.g., hover:text-white or hover:text-[#A775C9]).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds behind headers, overlays, dropdowns, or modals. Use frosted glass with backdrop-filter: blur(16px) or solid white.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with modular components, responsive desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav

grids.community_grid: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) with 2rem gap; 2-col on <=1024px, 1-col on <=640px
grids.learning_library_grid: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) with 1.25rem gap; 2-col on <=1024px, 1-col on <=700px

card_radii.card_large: 24px to 28px (community cards, roadmap cards, learning cards)
card_radii.inner_widget: 12px to 16px (comment bubbles, chat bubbles, input bars)

student_learning_workspace.description: Student working on modern programming workflow and learning modules

diverse_collaborative_mentorship.description: Mentorship and discussion exchange between community learners

collaborative_coding_session.description: Students reviewing frontend interfaces and discussing product solutions

rules: Render feed cards with author avatar initials or photo, community chip badge, timestamp, post title, and body preview.
Include one-level reply rendering inside the discussion modal with nested indent (ml-6 or 1.5rem indent) and distinct secondary accent border-left (#D480BB).
Author management controls (edit/delete) must be shown only for authenticated author matching post user_id.
Bookmark/Save toggle must reflect optimistic active state with filled bookmark icon and state persistence to saved_posts table in Supabase.
Display sidebar channel list representing communities user can explore or participate in.
Show real-time message stream with member avatars, bold usernames, formatted timestamps, and smooth auto-scroll to latest message on receive.
Disable message input or show friendly banner if user is not signed in or not a member of the active community with one-click 'Join to Chat' button.
Include 'For You' and 'Browse All' toggle pills with active pill animation.
In 'For You' mode, filter resources matching active user profile career path and skills.
In 'Browse All' mode, enable dropdown filtering for Career, Skill, and search keyword.
Every resource card must show title, short synopsis, career tag, skill chips, duration, external/internal link button, and completion check toggle.
Completion toggle must update Supabase user_progress and user_resource_progress immediately with instant green Honeydew (#EAF7EC) badge update.
Each of the 7 roadmap days must display linked resource recommendations fetched from Supabase catalog.
Marking a roadmap day as completed must synchronize with resource completion state and recalculate journey progress percentage.

universal_rules: Avoid generic centered layouts; maintain clear visual hierarchy with deliberate left alignment for text and balanced widget distributions.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, toggles, filter dropdowns, modal triggers, save buttons) MUST have distinct data-testid attributes for testing.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and use specific transition definitions (e.g. transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease) rather than universal transition: all.
Do not add .App { text-align: center; } or center body text.
Preserve Luma's existing visual language: soft pill badges, subtle glowing radial backgrounds (8-12% opacity), crisp 1px borders, and colored drop shadows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Fix session hydration on page load: ensure window.lumaAuthReady or client.auth.getSession() completes before rendering auth-dependent features, preventing flash of unauthenticated state.
Resolve updateSelectedCareer ReferenceError by ensuring global career state helpers are declared in window scope or imported properly across app.js, learning-hub.js, and discovery-board.js.
Preserve all existing vanilla HTML/JS/CSS architecture without introducing React or changing backend infrastructure from FastAPI + Supabase.
Ensure all Supabase queries handle RLS and clock skew retries gracefully as defined in supabase-client.js.

Seed realistic demo community posts, comments, replies, channels, and resource records so public preview at https://community-feed-131.preview.emergentagent.com looks vibrant and immediately interactive.
